name: @openjobspec/wasm
description: OJS (Open Job Spec) client SDK compiled to WebAssembly — works in browsers, Service Workers, and edge runtimes

scripts.build: rm -rf pkg && wasm-pack build --target web --release --out-dir pkg && node scripts/prepare-package.mjs pkg
scripts.build:bundler: rm -rf pkg-bundler && wasm-pack build --target bundler --release --out-dir pkg-bundler && node scripts/prepare-package.mjs pkg-bundler
scripts.build:nodejs: rm -rf pkg-node && wasm-pack build --target nodejs --release --out-dir pkg-node && node scripts/prepare-package.mjs pkg-node
